title: Dynamic analysis of geometrically non-linear three-dimensional beams under moving mass
publisher: Elsevier, Journal of Sound and Vibration, Volume 413 (2018), pp. 354–367
author: Dejan Zupan; Eva Zupan
locator: Abstract and introduction: coupled structural and moving-particle equations; path coordinate introduced as an additional unknown and adapted to structural deformation
notes: Supports the methodological distinction between prescribed-path moving load and a coupled moving-particle/structure model. Its geometrically nonlinear beam/FEM formulation is not a parameter source or direct validation for the reduced CNC gantry model.
